name: gui_close
title: Close Application
description: Close a GUI application previously launched via gui_launch, by its reported process id. Only PIDs the agent launched in this boot are accepted; anything else fails with GUI_PID_NOT_MANAGED instead of touching foreign processes. Use for GUI lifecycle cleanup, not for operating-system processes (use process_terminate with a managed handle for those).

client_id.description: Target HHC client. Absolute routing handle, independent of any connection.

pid.description: Process id previously reported by gui_launch on the same host.

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

tool.description: Echo of the invoked tool name.

client_id.description: Echo of the target host id (null when no host was targeted).

error.description: Machine-readable error code when status is failed.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.
